varieties.name: Managu (Solanum scabrum)
varieties.supplier_notes: Local Kenyan managu; broad leaves; main commercial type.

varieties.name: Olevu (S. villosum)
varieties.supplier_notes: Smaller leaves but tastier; village-market preferred.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow in raised nursery bed at 1cm depth. Tiny seed — barely cover.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda kitalu kina 1cm. Mbegu ndogo — funika kidogo sana.
Weka kilo 50 za CAN. Huongeza majani.

timeline_template.description_en: Pluck top 2-3 leaves and tender stems. Don't strip the whole plant.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chuna majani 2-3 ya juu na shina laini. Usimaliz e mmea wote.
timeline_template.tip_en: First harvest delayed = sweeter taste, less bitter compounds.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Mavuno ya kwanza ukichelewa = ladha tamu zaidi.

timeline_template.description_en: Continue plucking every 7-10 days for 3 months.
timeline_template.description_sw: Endelea kuchuna kila siku 7-10 kwa miezi 3.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Bunched leaves + tender stems. Reject yellowed or seeded shoots.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: Tied bunches ~200g, sold same-day at market.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Sell same-day. Cool 5-10°C if delay forced.
